name: Chichi Ninja ~Matenrou e Chichi Bomber~
original_name: 乳忍者～摩天楼へ乳ボンバー～
source:
During the day they work as innocent OL. But their true identity is ninja who protect peace of Japan. Tonight breast ninja defeat enemy spies with overwhelming strength again. Two ninja have their doubts and as if in return get a dangerous enemy - Amazon ninja. The story develops radically as more and more strong enemies show up.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
白天，她们是天真无害的职业女性；真实身份却是守护日本和平的忍者。今夜，乳忍者再次以压倒性力量击败敌国间谍。两名忍者心中产生疑惑，仿佛回应她们的动摇一般，危险强敌——亚马逊忍者——随即现身。随着越来越多强敌登场，故事也开始急剧发展。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
